comment: In the Pitch Down branch for three channels the final swap of elements 0 and 1 has no `if (volt_In[0] < volt_In[1])` guard, unlike the matching Pitch Up branch, so the swap is unconditional and a descending input is left mis-sorted. The outputs are never zeroed when the channel count drops, so they hold stale voltages. The jacks carry whatever is patched to them, so no family is set.
